page: OVHcloud r3-1024 is a memory-optimized cloud server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated 128-core AMD EPYC processor based on the x86_64 architecture operating at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The CPU deployment offers dedicated core mapping with one thread per core, totaling 128 physical cores. The instance is configured with 1024 GB of system memory, yielding an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Storage is bundled as a single 400 GB local NVMe SSD, and the instance connects to network infrastructure with a baseline throughput of 20 Gbps. No discrete GPUs are included in the configuration.

Benchmark evaluations reveal substantial throughput across multi-core compute and memory subsystems. In multi-threaded execution, the instance achieves top-tier results in stress-ng multi-core testing (288,167.36) and PassMark CPU scoring (113,820.59), alongside strong Clang software compilation and ray-tracing performance. Memory subsystems demonstrate high bandwidth, reaching 9,921.46 GB/s on small cached reads and maintaining top-tier PassMark memory rankings. High-concurrency data operations are evidenced by Redis SET operations processing 166.68 million operations per second. Conversely, single-threaded performance remains in the middle 50% tier, with Geekbench single-core reaching 1,903.0 and single-threaded gzip registering 29.13 GB/s, reflecting the moderate 2.3 GHz frequency.

The hardware configuration provides high density for memory-bound workloads that benefit from dedicated non-hyperthreaded physical cores. However, the bundled 400 GB NVMe SSD is small relative to the terabyte-scale memory pool, presenting an operational tradeoff if local persistent storage needs exceed baseline limits. Furthermore, absent GPU acceleration, large language model text generation falls to bottom-tier performance, producing 2.26 tokens per second on 70B parameter models. OVHcloud r3-1024 is suited for large in-memory databases, massive Redis caching tiers, parallel code build pipelines, and data-intensive analytics platforms.
description: OVHcloud r3-1024 is a memory-optimized cloud server built for data-intensive and parallel enterprise workloads. Powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC processor, it provides 128 dedicated physical cores at 2.3 GHz with a single thread per core and 1024 GB of RAM, offering 8.0 GB of memory per core. Bundled infrastructure includes a 400 GB local NVMe SSD and a 20 Gbps baseline network interface, with zero discrete GPUs. Synthetic benchmarks show top-tier multi-core computing and memory performance, evidenced by 166.68 million Redis SET operations per second and high multi-threaded decompression rates. Single-thread performance is balanced in the median range due to the clock frequency, and text generation on large language models is constrained by the lack of accelerators. The server fits in-memory database deployments, caching clusters, and large parallel compilation tasks.
